instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: GrowthFlow Solutions is a B2B SaaS provider specializing in customized project management and resource allocation software for mid-sized engineering firms. We operate primarily online, servicing clients across various industries.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have recently implemented a phased rollout of an AI-driven reporting module and successfully integrated two new CRM connectors to expand our feature set.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is aggressive market share expansion within the European SME segment over the next three years. This involves driving user adoption by 40% through product enhancement and securing key enterprise contracts.
answers.teamSize: The core development team consists of 15 specialized engineers, supported by a small product management unit focused on iterative delivery.

opportunities.title: Tiered Feature Unlock Strategy
opportunities.rationale: To drive growth conservatively, we should incrementally introduce premium features behind a lower-cost tier to capture new segments without risking core product stability.

first_actions: Define three tiers based on feature complexity.
Prototype the 'Growth Package' module within one month.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in Premium Tier conversion rate by 15% within Q3.

opportunities.title: Targeted Niche Vertical Integration
opportunities.rationale: Focusing resources on integrating specialized compliance modules for the Healthcare Tech niche offers a lower-risk entry point into high-value markets.

first_actions: Conduct market gap analysis for healthcare compliance needs.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 pilot clients in the Healthcare Tech sector within 9 months.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized Predictive Analytics Engine
opportunities.rationale: To achieve high growth, we must explore a radical shift in our data processing capabilities to offer unique predictive insights that competitors cannot easily replicate.

first_actions: Form an internal 'Moonshot' task force (5-7 key engineers).
Allocate $20,000 for exploratory AI/ML R&D tools.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 90% prediction accuracy for client churn within 18 months.
milestones: MVP deployment of predictive engine: Month 12

next_steps.action: Finalize the product roadmap for the 'Growth Package' tier and assign engineering leads.
Initiate a formal feasibility study for the Predictive Analytics Engine (Moonshot project).
Conduct a comprehensive review of current talent capabilities to identify skill gaps necessary for aggressive growth.

key_weaknesses: Scalability limitations in the core architecture as user base grows significantly.
High dependency on a few key engineering talent pools, leading to potential turnover risk.
Slow internal process for migrating legacy code to modern microservices infrastructure.
